[[File:NalanCheel-VD.jpg|thumb|250px|Nalan Cheel playing a bandfill]]
The '''bandfill''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument, commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]], that featured a number of mounted horn bells called reciprocator horns and a [[Ploong sounder/Legends|ploong sounder]]. Notable bandfill players include [[Nalan Cheel/Legends|Nalan Cheel]] of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]].
